_comment: Price book for the chargeback report. Rates are USD per MCP tool call.
Keys are '<server>.<tool>' using the ORIGIN server and tool names — the same
names the authorization rules in manifests/security/ match on.
The point of a price book is that not every call is worth the same. A funnel
query costs real warehouse compute; a bulk dataset export costs compute plus
egress; reading a cached invoice costs almost nothing. Metering per call and
pricing per tool lets the rate card reflect that instead of averaging it away.
Edit freely — chargeback.py re-reads this file on every run.
